title: Agoda Prices

locationQueries.title: Destinations
locationQueries.description: Cities or areas as typed into Agoda, e.g. ["Bangkok"], ["Lisbon", "Bali"], an Agoda city id ("16364") or an agoda.com search URL. Each is resolved through Agoda's own autocomplete (best match wins; add the country for ambiguous names) and becomes one search returning up to maxHotelsPerQuery priced properties in sortBy order. An unmatched place is a free status row, nothing charged. Empty = price only the hotels named below. Use for "hotel prices in Bangkok next month".

hotelIds.title: Hotel ids
hotelIds.description: Agoda numeric property ids, e.g. ["63820", "6988894"]: the hotel_id column of an earlier run. The fastest way to price a known list every day (a comp set, a portfolio): one small request per hotel, no page read. An unknown id is a free status row (not_found). A hotel given twice, or reached by a destination search too, is delivered and billed once. Add calendarDays for each hotel's cheapest dates.

hotelNames.title: Hotel names
hotelNames.description: Property names, e.g. ["Tivoli Avenida Liberdade Lisbon", "Mandarin Oriental Bangkok"]: add the city. Resolved through Agoda's own autocomplete; the best match is priced on its own for the stay, and the free status row carries hotel_name and hotel_id, so check it. A name that matches nothing costs nothing. sortBy and maxHotelsPerQuery do not apply to named hotels; the filters do. Use for "what does hotel X cost on these dates".

startUrls.title: Agoda URLs
startUrls.description: Agoda URLs, e.g. ["https://www.agoda.com/tivoli-avenida-liberdade/hotel/lisbon-pt.html"]: a property page is priced on its own (the page is read once to find its id); a search URL (agoda.com/search?city=…) is treated like a destination. URLs from other sites are refused before anything is charged. Prefer hotelIds when you have them.

checkIn.title: Check-in
checkIn.description: Check-in date: "2026-11-20" (YYYY-MM-DD) or relative to the day the run starts: "30 days" (default), "6 weeks", "tomorrow". Use relative dates for scheduled runs ("track prices daily"): the input never goes stale. Check-out = checkIn + nights. A past date is refused before anything is charged. The price calendar (calendarDays) starts here too.

nights.title: Nights
nights.description: Length of stay, 1 to 30, e.g. 2 (default 1). price_total and price_total_with_taxes cover the whole stay for all rooms; price_nightly is per room per night.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Adults per booking, 1 to 9, e.g. 2 (default 2). Agoda prices the cheapest room that fits everyone; the price calendar is read at this adult count.

children.title: Children
children.description: Children per booking, 0 to 9, e.g. 1 (default 0). Give their ages in childAges for exact child rates.

childAges.title: Child ages
childAges.description: One age per child, 0 to 17, in order, e.g. ["5", "9"] for two children aged 5 and 9. Empty (default) = no children. Give one age for each child counted in children.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms per booking, 1 to 9, e.g. 1 (default 1). Nightly prices are per room; totals cover all rooms for the stay.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code for every price, e.g. "THB" (default "USD"): USD, EUR, GBP, THB, JPY, SGD, AUD, … converted at Agoda's own rate. When the user names no currency, pass the destination's ("THB" for Bangkok).

maxHotelsPerQuery.title: Max hotels per destination
maxHotelsPerQuery.description: Priced properties per destination search, e.g. 100 (default 45 = one Agoda page). The main cost control: at most maxHotelsPerQuery × $0.004 per destination. Taken in sortBy order; the filters then drop rows, so 100 asked with maxPrice set can deliver fewer. 0 = every property Agoda lists for the stay, up to 40 pages (about 1,800 properties, up to $7.20 for a capital); values above that end at the same 40-page limit. The rank column is the position in that order. Not applied to named hotels.
maxHotelsPerQuery.sectionCaption: How many hotels, sort and filters (before billing)

sortBy.title: Sort destination results
sortBy.description: Agoda's own order for destination searches: "best_match" (default, Agoda's ranking), "price_low" (cheapest first; Agoda only sorts price ascending), "guest_rating" (highest score first), "secret_deals". Use "price_low" with maxHotelsPerQuery for "the 20 cheapest hotels in Bangkok". The rank and sort columns record it. Ignored for named hotels.

maxPrice.title: Max nightly price
maxPrice.description: Highest nightly price in `currency`, e.g. 80. 0 (default) = no cap. Keeps hotels whose price_nightly (per room per night, before taxes: Agoda's displayed price) is at or under it. Dropped hotels are never delivered or billed: a daily "anything under 80" alert costs nothing on days without a match. Applies to destination searches and named hotels. Use for "hotels under 80 USD a night".

minStars.title: Min star rating
minStars.description: Lowest star rating to keep, 0 to 5, e.g. 4 (= 4-star and 5-star properties). 0 (default) = any. Applied by the actor before billing, so dropped properties are free. Unrated properties (many apartments, hostels and Agoda Homes) have no stars and are dropped when this is set: use minReviewScore for those instead.

minReviewScore.title: Min guest score
minReviewScore.description: Lowest guest review score to keep, 0 to 10, e.g. 8 (default 0 = any). Compared with review_score, Agoda's combined score across the sources it aggregates; unreviewed properties are dropped when this is set. Applied before billing. Use for "well-rated hotels only" or to rank hostels and apartments that have no stars.

freeCancellationOnly.title: Free cancellation only
freeCancellationOnly.description: false (default) = every priced hotel, with free_cancellation true or false on each row. true = keep only hotels whose cheapest rate is free to cancel (cancellation = FreeCancellation); the rest are dropped free of charge. Use for "refundable hotels only".

calendarDays.title: Price calendar days (properties only)
calendarDays.description: 0 (default) disables calendars. N prices up to 60 check-in dates from checkIn for named hotels (hotelIds, hotelNames or property URLs), not destination searches. One live request per date; only priced dates produce rows. Fields: price_nightly, price_total, rank_in_window and trend where available. Each calendar row costs $0.002, plus the base hotel row at $0.004. Example: 20 hotels × 60 priced dates = $2.40 calendar fees + $0.08 hotel fees = $2.48. Unpriced dates are free.

includeSoldOut.title: Include sold-out properties
includeSoldOut.description: false (default) = only priced hotels, so the dataset is a price list. true = also write a free row for every property Agoda lists but cannot price for the stay, with sold_out true and every price empty: an occupancy signal for a destination. Sold-out rows are never charged either way; a named hotel with no rate gets status sold_out.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Agoda locale for hotel names, areas and city labels, e.g. "en-us" (default), "ja-jp", "th-th", "ko-kr", "zh-cn", "de-de". Prices and currency are not affected (set currency instead).

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (egress IPs), 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 4). More is faster; each session is paced separately by perIp. Leave the default unless Agoda throttles.

perIp.title: Requests per second per session
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 3, e.g. 1 (default 1). Agoda tolerates about one request per second per IP; faster causes retries, not speed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (default, datacenter group) is required: Agoda throttles a single busy IP within a few pages. Datacenter proxies are enough for this endpoint; residential is not needed.

description: Agoda hotel prices. Minimal input: {"locationQueries": ["Bangkok"]} (checkIn defaults to "30 days", 1 night, 2 adults, USD) or {"hotelIds": ["63820"]} or {"hotelNames": ["Mandarin Oriental Bangkok"]} — at least one target input. maxHotelsPerQuery defaults to 45 (one page, up to $0.18 per destination at $0.004 a hotel); 0 = every hotel Agoda lists (about 1,800 for a capital). calendarDays defaults to 0 (calendar rows $0.002 each, named hotels only).
